verdict.rationale: Poly documents a 'flashback mode' that shows exactly what files looked like at any point in the past, down to the millisecond (poly-docs-5). Its recovering-files page states that even conflicting edits are preserved, so any version of any file can be recovered at any time (poly-docs-10). Together these cover viewing history and restoring earlier versions. missing for 10: explicit documentation of recovering deleted notes (trash or undelete), detail on the restore workflow and UI, independent or hands-on corroboration.
